d:
The Nuggets defeated the Raptors, 128-109 tonight in Denver. Nikola Jokić contributed a team-high 32 points to go with 11 assists 10 rebounds and 3 steals, with Bryce Hopkins of the Nuggets adding an additional 18 points (6-7 FG, 1-1 3P) in the game. RJ Barrett finished with a team-high 22 points along with 5 rebounds for the Raptors in the losing effort. The Nuggets improve their record to 4-3 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 4-4 for the season.
